question: Which additional substances continue the enumeration of ritual ingredients?
premises: These belong to the same preparation
inference: Soḍumbara, kāśmarikā, sthirā, abja, dara, puṣpikā, and mayūraśikhā are additional ingredients.
uncertainties: Exact botanical identifications of several substances are uncertain
plain_english: Soḍumbara, kāśmarikā, sthirā, abja, dara, puṣpikā, and mayūraśikhā.
